build_command: RUNNER_UID=<verified bootstrap UID> RUNNER_GID=<verified bootstrap GID> BUILD-OPERATOR.sh (fresh private WORK/context and newly absent WORK/image.iid; docker build --pull=false)
identity_rule: build must exit 0; iidfile must contain sha256:<64hex>; inspect must target exactly that ID; image ID and RepoDigests remain separate; tag is never identity
operator_rule: each invocation uses a fresh private mktemp context and iidfile; failed or ambiguous runs retain work evidence and cannot inspect or accept a tag
